cache_conditions.dependency_store: warm - the host shared pnpm store is already populated, and the install runs against it
cache_conditions.git_objects: cold per trial - every trial clones into a fresh directory with no pre-existing objects
cache_conditions.page_cache: not purged - purging is a whole-machine operation on a shared host, so cold and warm describe tool-level caches only

filesystem_class: APFS - hard links and copy-on-write file clones both supported

measurement_methods.allocated_bytes: st_blocks * 512; on APFS this counts every copy-on-write clone at full size and therefore cannot see sharing
measurement_methods.charged_disk_bytes: free-space delta across the provisioning run, which is the only measure that sees copy-on-write sharing on this filesystem class
measurement_methods.profile_identity: sha256 over the manifest version and the Git blob id of each declared identity input; the revision is bound separately into provision_identity
